purpose: Source-controlled asset inventory for ChatGPT/project context. This is not a Visual Asset Registry package and does not contain image bytes.

registered_visual_asset_registry.reason: The app stores registered Visual Assets in browser IndexedDB (lam-motion-studio.visual-assets); that browser profile is not accessible from this workspace scan.
registered_visual_asset_registry.how_to_export: Open the app's Visual Assets manager and use Export Package to export manifest.json and the associated assets/ files.

published_character_library.reason: Published character records are stored in the local server SQLite database under data/character-library.sqlite; they are a separate library from files in assets/.
published_character_library.how_to_export: Use the Character Library migration/export flow in the app to create a Published JSON backup.

assets.description: SVG sprite pose of Lam Educator explaining.
assets.usage: Use as a character pose in scenes that need an educator explaining a topic.

assets.description: SVG sprite pose of Lam Educator greeting.
assets.usage: Use as a character pose for an introduction or greeting.

assets.description: SVG sprite pose of Lam Educator standing in a neutral idle pose.
assets.usage: Use as the default standing pose when no specific gesture is required.

assets.description: SVG sprite pose of Lam Educator pointing.
assets.usage: Use when the character should point to a diagram, label, or on-screen object.

chatgpt_instructions: Treat each path as an asset available in the project source.
Use the exact path/asset_id when referring to one of these poses.
Do not assume other registered Visual Assets are present based on this inventory; the browser registry must be exported separately.
Do not substitute a generated image when a requested pose is explicitly available, unless the project policy permits substitution.
